ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Accepted"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Account.Non_Profit_Status__c, "Verified - Not in Good Standing"), ISPICKVAL(Account.Non_Profit_Status__c, "Not Verified") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This application cannot be approved due to the non-profit status of the related account. Please check the account for details.
